titles.native: B-伝説! バトルビーダマン 炎魂

description:
In this sequel to Battle B-Daman, our hero from the past, Yamato and the gang go on a journey to collect the Marble “Strike Shot” which qualifies for the B-Daman World Championship, “WINNERS”. Their final destination is the stadium for this fierce battle. Who are the ones to survive an impossible series of ordeals and make their way through to the stadium? And then, who will be the one to reach the top of the championship by defeating all rivals at WINNERS?

(Source: d-rights)
